text:
maria: quick heads-up — smoke test caught a dead anchor in /runtime/kv-cache.md, linked from the caching section in onboarding. link: `https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#peer-cache`. repro: open page -> click ‘peer-cache’ in left TOC -> 404. Who owns runtime docs atm? Can someone quick-assign?

simon: i'll take a look. is this ok as a redirect to #kv-cache-v2 or do we want to re-add the anchor?

alex: short-term +1 for redirect. i can open a tiny PR: sed replace anchor to `#kv-cache-v2` and add a short note in changelog. ping me with the file path.

jen: cc @simon @alex FYI we have a localization backfill scheduled next week — if we change anchors we should patch ja/ and es/ as well. keep it minimal please.

docs-bot: link-scan detected 1 broken anchor in runtime/kv-cache.md — ticket DOCS-4382 created (auto). https://issues.internal.redwood/DOCS-4382

simon: thanks. @alex please open the PR against `main`. i'll review and merge once CI passes. note: add a tiny anchor redirect in frontmatter like:
```
redirect_from:
 - /runtime/kv-cache#peer-cache
```

maria: thanks all. @alex can you drop the PR URL here when ready? i'll loop in support for the customer follow-up.

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-infer/docs/pull/4123 — small sed + redirect frontmatter. added quick note in runtime changelog. tagging @simon for review.

simon: lgtm, merging after CI. :shipit:

maria: awesome, thanks. marking as resolved on my end — will update the customer. :thumbsup:
